metadata.description: Validation case for dollar-linked Treasury letra D30N6, reconciled against the IAMC daily report of 05-Oct-2026. Research R-006 is NOT implementation-approved: this case documents the reconciliation, it does not authorize production use.

contractual_data.fx_settlement_rule: A3500 of the 3rd business day prior to the amortization payment date

contractual_source.publisher: Ministerio de Economía de la Nación
contractual_source.issued_amount_cross_check: IAMC reports 63M; colocaciones original tranche matches within rounding

market_data.market_source: IAMC — Informe Diario Títulos Públicos, close 05-Oct-2026
market_data.fx_conversion_rate_status: IMPLIED — NOT OFFICIAL. Solved from the published peso prices and published yields across the five letras in the table. The BCRA A3500 of 05-Oct-2026 is 1520.00 (+0.203% difference). The conversion rule is open question Q5 of R-006.

methodology.derived_rates_formula: TEM = (1 + TEA) ^ (1/12) - 1 ; TNA = TEM * 12 (R-004 relationships, owner decision 2026-10-26)
methodology.duration_formula: MacD = D / 365 ; MD = MacD / (1 + TEA) (R-005, single payment)
methodology.day_count_method: Actual calendar days from settlement to maturity, ACT/365 effective annualization
methodology.precision_policy: Decimal, no intermediate rounding; published values and recalculated values remain distinct.

expected_results.peso_total_return_note: Requires a devaluation assumption governed by R-009 (no production approval). Not computed.

validation.maturity_value_status: Not Applicable (redemption at par 100 in linked units)
validation.market_data_status: Validated (price published; FX conversion rule open — Q5)
validation.yield_metrics_status: Reconciled against IAMC: engine TEA 5.90% vs published 5.89%
validation.duration_status: Reconciled against IAMC published DM at published precision
validation.secondary_reference: examples/1790870714941.pdf — Informe de Renta Fija (Robles Alvarez / BYMA), close 30-Sep-2026
